summary: Synthetic 2x2 counterexample shows individually authorized source-read and sink-send effects can compose into an unauthorized end-to-end flow if Assembly provenance is lost. Existing Safe-Effect Geometry already contains authority non-amplification and information-flow confinement, so the delta is a concrete composition test/receipt obligation rather than a new semantic layer.
actionable: ClayCode CC-WP-04: preserve protected-source labels and capability provenance through composition
ClayCode CC-WP-07: validate effective end-to-end authority at external commit boundary
ClayCode CC-WP-09: define provenance/label behavior across async queues/shared Assembly state
ClayCode CC-WP-11: fuzz pairs/chains of locally authorized effects for composite violations
Harness: add confused-deputy and source-to-sink composition matrix across FFI/subprocess/tools/generated code
GWT/Emergenz: retain factorial interaction and matched replay as non-authoritative observability for composite effect paths
negative_result: No evidence supports a new permanent branch or broad ClayCode semantic redesign; current Safe-Effect foundation already expresses the target invariants.
